data.case_title: Guardianship Court Hearing Invitation (Betreuungsverfahren) for Mother
data.explanation: The Betreuungsgericht (guardianship court) in Musterwernigerode is handling a case about appointing a legal guardian (Betreuer) for your mother, Gertrud Beispielharz. As her son, the court wants to hear your views and has scheduled a hearing at the care home where she lives. Your attendance is welcomed but not legally required (not enforceable). If you can't make it, you may instead send your views in writing to the court before or around that date. There is no payment or formal deadline to meet here — just the option to attend or write in.
